extracted.intended_audience: KIPO patent examiners and patent applicants/agents handling foreign‑language patent applications in Korea
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for examination and amendment of patent applications filed in a foreign language in Korea, including submission of Korean translations, correction of mistranslations, and evaluation of introduction of new matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline for Korean translations for divisional/converted applications
rubrics_metrics.description: If a divisional application or a converted application is filed in a foreign language, the Korean translations shall be submitted within 30 days from the date of a divisional or a converted application being filed, even though the period of 1 year and 2 months have already been lapsed from the filing date of the parent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Korean translations shall be submitted accompanied by document submission form [Article 21(3) of the Exceptional Provisions to the Patent Act, Form No. 13]. The Korean translations of a foreign language specification (a “word-for-word translation” into Korean in accordance with the context of the foreign language specification) shall be submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement that Korean translations be 'word-for-word' in context
rubrics_metrics.description: The Korean translations of a foreign language specification shall be a “word-for-word translation” into Korean in accordance with the context of the foreign language specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translations should faithfully represent the original; when mistranslations are later corrected, corrections must be supported and evaluated for appropriateness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequence of failing to submit Korean translations of the specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the Korean translations of foreign language specification are not submitted, the patent application concerned shall be deemed to have been withdrawn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to submit the Korean translation of the specification is treated as withdrawal of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequence of failing to submit Korean translations of drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the Korean translations of drawing(s) (the text matter only) are not submitted, the patent application concerned shall not be deemed to have been withdrawn as is different from the case of a specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: However, amendment to the application shall be able to be instructed on grounds of violation of the written description requirement of drawing(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of submitting Korean translations (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Korean translations are submitted, a foreign language specification originally attached to the application thereof shall be deemed to have been amended according to the Korean translations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After submission of Korean translations, the application is examined and publicly inspected in Korean; a patent is granted after reviewing a Korean specification. Only after Korean translations are submitted may the applicant file a request for examination, amend the specification, file divisional or converted applications, and request early publication (Articles cited).

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal status of translations after 2015 amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to the amended Patent Act (enforced Jan 1, 2015), the Korean translations submitted shall not be regarded as a specification, but the foreign language specification shall be deemed to be amended with the submission of the filed Korean translations, from the applicant’s point of view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although translations are not formally the specification, they have amendment effects for examination; new matter introduced in translations is evaluated accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Default basis for evaluating introduction of new matter
rubrics_metrics.description: To evaluate whether new matter is introduced in a specification and drawings of a foreign language patent application shall basically be based on the scope of the disclosure of the Korean translations unless exceptional circumstances have occurred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where a mistranslation is corrected, introduction of new matter shall be examined based on the Korean translations, but depending on appropriateness of the correction, it may be evaluated based on the foreign language specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination where no correction of mistranslations is made
rubrics_metrics.description: Where no correction of mistranslation is made, it shall be sufficient for the examiner to examine whether a specification and drawing(s) under examination are within the scope of the Korean translations, without examining whether the specification or drawing(s) amended according to the Korean translations is within the scope of the disclosure of the foreign language patent application, unless there are considerable events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner need not compare to the original foreign text in every case unless relevant information or reasonable doubt arises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination where correction of mistranslations is made
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a correction of mistranslations is made, the examiner shall closely examine whether an amendment to the specification under examination is made within the scope of the disclosure of the foreign language specification or corrected Korean translations. Introduction of new matter in a specification and drawing(s) subject to examination shall be closely evaluated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corrections trigger closer scrutiny to ensure amendments do not introduce new matter beyond the original disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory requirement for amendments (Article 47(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: An amendment to the specification or drawings shall be made within the scope of the disclosure of the specification or drawings as originally filed. An amendment to a foreign language patent application shall be also made within the scope of the disclosures of the final Korean translation (referring to the corrected Korean translation, if any correction is made) or of the drawings as originally filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the controlling legal standard for permissible amendments to foreign-language applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grounds for rejection and invalidation when amendment exceeds scope
rubrics_metrics.description: An examiner shall make a decision to reject a patent application if an amendment to the patent application exceeds the scope described in Article 47(2). Likewise, introduction of new matter beyond the disclosure of the foreign language specification constitutes grounds for rejection (Article 62(5)) and grounds for invalidation (Article 133(1)vi).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendments beyond the permitted scope can lead to rejection and, post-grant, invalidation.

rubrics_metrics.name: When an amendment beyond Korean translations constitutes rejection but not invalidation
rubrics_metrics.description: Where an amendment is made within the scope of disclosure of a foreign language specification but beyond the scope of the Korean translations, it shall constitute grounds for rejection but not grounds for invalidation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between rejection (procedural/examination stage) and invalidation (post-grant substantive challenge).

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of implicit or inherent disclosure in Korean translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Besides the explicit disclosure of the Korean translations, implicit or inherent disclosure of the Korean translations shall be treated as the ‘disclosure of the Korean translation’.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assessing new matter, examiners consider not only explicit statements but also what is implicitly or inherently disclosed to the skilled person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's possible responses to a notice of new matter beyond Korean translations
rubrics_metrics.description: If rejection on the ground of the introduction of new matter beyond the disclosure of the Korean translations is issued, a patent applicant shall make a response as follows: (i) submit a written argument that new matter is not introduced beyond the disclosure of the Korean translations; (ii) delete the new matter by amending the specification/drawings; (iii) for new matter resulting from mistranslation, submit correction of a mistranslation attaching relevant documentary material and argue the matter is resolved by correction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner will consider written arguments; deleting offending content or correcting mistranslation with documentary support are remedial paths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for evaluating new matter beyond the foreign language specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for evaluating new matter beyond the disclosure of the foreign language specification (including foreign-language international applications) is the same as the one applied in a regular patent application—evaluate whether matters described in the specification under examination are explicitly disclosed or implicitly/inherently disclosed in the foreign language specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even changes in sentence order in translations do not necessarily introduce new matter if no substantive new content is introduced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Example showing mistranslation can create new matter (Ca -> K)
rubrics_metrics.description: If [Ca] of a foreign language specification is mistranslated into [K or potassium], as the foreign language specification only discloses [Ca], [K or potassium] disclosed in a translated specification shall not be deemed to fall within the scope of matters described in the foreign language specification and therefore constitutes new matter beyond the disclosure of the foreign language specification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete mistranslation of chemical element names illustrates how translation errors can create impermissible new matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: When to compare original foreign text with Korean translations
rubrics_metrics.description: Where it is doubtful of consistency between the foreign language specification and a specification for examination, both documents shall be compared with each other. The examiner shall evaluate proscription against the introduction of new matter taking into account the foreign language specification mainly in certain cases (e.g., third-party information, family application arguments, international preliminary examination report).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiners are not required to compare in every case, but must do so when reasonable doubt or specific information suggests inconsistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Situations triggering comparison (third-party info, family files, IPRP)
rubrics_metrics.description: The specification needs to be compared with the foreign language specification when: (1) information indicates the specification submitted for examination includes new matter beyond the foreign language specification and there is reasonable doubt; (2) the written argument of the international preliminary examination report describes new matter or new matter is disclosed in review of family application examination results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include credible third-party submissions alleging new matter, or family-filed written arguments indicating inconsistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required content for statement and documentary materials when correcting a mistranslation
rubrics_metrics.description: To correct a mistranslation, a statement of correction of a mistranslation shall be submitted attaching documentary materials describing reasons for correction. Documentary materials shall clearly describe: (i) the matters described in the foreign language specification are comparable to the amendment; (ii) inappropriateness of the Korean translation before amendment; (iii) appropriateness of the Korean translation after amendment, so that a person skilled in the art shall confirm correction is not beyond the original disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Power of attorney and payment of relevant fees are also required; if reasons are insufficient, amendment to the statement shall be ordered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of correction of mistranslation on permissible amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the Korean translation is corrected as it has mistranslation, introduction of new matter beyond the disclosure of the Korean translation shall be examined based on the corrected Korean documents (final version of the Korean translation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corrected Korean translation becomes the reference for evaluating new matter, but correction itself does not automatically have amendment effect (see next criterion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction during amendment period does not have amendment effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Correction of Korean translations made during the period for amending a specification or drawings is not given an amendment effect. The corrected Korean translation due to mistranslation shall not have the same effect with the amendment to the specification or drawing(s). Therefore, where the Korean translation has mistranslation, amendment to a specification for examination shall be made, irrespective of the correction of the Korean translation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if translations are corrected, the applicant still must amend the specification/drawings explicitly to obtain amendment effect for examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination procedure when correction of mistranslation is reasonable
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the corrected Korean translation sufficiently conforms to a foreign language specification as correction of mistranslation is confirmed to be reasonable, examination differs depending on whether a specification for examination is amended or not: (i) If specification for examination is not amended (it matches the un-corrected Korean translation), a notification of grounds for rejection shall be issued for introduction of new matter beyond the disclosure of the foreign language specification and the Korean translation. (ii) If the specification is amended within the scope of matters described in the corrected Korean translation, regular examination proceeds; if amendment is beyond scope, grounds for rejection shall be closely reviewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reasonable correction allows use of corrected translation as reference, but the specification must be amended appropriately to avoid rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination procedure when correction of mistranslation is unreasonable
rubrics_metrics.description: Where mistranslation is improperly corrected so that corrected Korean translation does not conform to the foreign language specification, examination differs depending on whether the specification is amended: (i) If not amended (identical with un-corrected Korean translation), issue notice of grounds for rejection that the specification does not fall within scope of the Korean translation or original foreign application (in unnecessary correction cases, rejection only on ground beyond Korean translation). (ii) If amended based on the wrong correction, the amended specification is not likely to fall within the original foreign language application and rejection shall be issued on the ground of introduction of new matter beyond the original foreign language patent application. If amended specification differs from both correction and foreign text, rejection will be issued based on introduction of new matter beyond both.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Different combinations of correction and amendment determine whether rejection is based on Korean translation, foreign text, or both.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proscription categories: beyond foreign language spec; beyond Korean translation; beyond both
rubrics_metrics.description: If a specification for examination is amended such that it is beyond the scope of the foreign language specification (even after translation correction), a rejection shall be issued on the ground of introduction of new matter beyond the foreign language specification; similarly, if amendment is beyond the Korean translation (including unnecessary/irrelevant corrections), a rejection shall be issued on that ground; where amendment is beyond both the foreign language specification and the Korean translations, rejection shall be on both grounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flowchart examples (A->B->C etc.) illustrate when amendments after submission/correction constitute new matter causing rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Considerations regarding appropriateness of correction of a mistranslation
rubrics_metrics.description: (1) Appropriateness and inappropriateness of a mistranslation correction shall not themselves constitute reasons for rejection or reasons for amendment. (2) Where documentary materials do not sufficiently explain reasons for correction or are insufficient to evaluate appropriateness, amendment shall be ordered on the ground of insufficient reasons, and if amendment cannot relieve insufficiency, the correction may be invalidated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: arguments asserting mistranslation without objective explanation, or insufficient description that mistranslation resulted from interpretation/contextual error, may lead to order to amend or invalidation of the correction.
